(3) With `mailboxOwnerEmail`: any `recipient`, or `query` together with `sender` or a date. Keep `mailboxOwnerEmail` (and any `folderName`), drop `recipient` and `query`, send any `sender`/date filters, and check the returned subjects and recipients; retry with `query` alone (no `sender` or dates) only if nothing useful comes back. For \'emails I sent to X\' or \'the last thing I emailed X\', send `recipient` with no `folderName` or `order`, keep hits whose `sender` is the user or starts with `/O=`, pick the newest, and narrow with `afterDateTime` if the page is full.
